install.notes: The upstream class needs only the Python standard library (os and time, rigol.py:7-8), but the clone root must be importable and the operator supplies the USB TMC device file (the default is /dev/usbtmc2, rigol.py:13); the card lists no install command and the gate never installs or imports the upstream. The license is NOASSERTION/unknown: the clone contains no LICENSE file, so publication needs the owner's review.
